summary_hint: brokerage/custodian, registration (owner + type), statement period, and the account's ending value with its usable (net-of-margin, vested) portion

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity — validates source/third-party independence of the statement

typed_core.name: brokerage_or_custodian_name
typed_core.why: identity — the custodian holding the assets (independence check); may differ from the branding issuer

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — separates a periodic statement from a trade confirmation or year-end summary (different value semantics)

typed_core.name: account_registration_names_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim registration line; lets the tag layer re-judge a bad owner split

typed_core.name: account_owner_name
typed_core.why: identity — attach the account to a borrower (AS-3/AS-4 count only borrower-owned assets)

typed_core.name: account_owner_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — joint registration second owner

typed_core.name: account_owner_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — how many owners the registration names (joint vs individual affects attribution)

typed_core.name: registration_type
typed_core.why: AS-3/AS-4 disambiguator — individual/joint/trust/UTMA/IRA affects ownership eligibility and reserve treatment

typed_core.name: account_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII (restricted); account-grouping key across statements
typed_core.prompt_hint: Never emit the full account number; mask to last 4

typed_core.name: statement_date
typed_core.why: identity/recency — as-of date of the values

typed_core.name: statement_period_start
typed_core.why: recency/coverage — statement window opening

typed_core.name: statement_period_end
typed_core.why: AS-3/AS-4 use the most-recent value; recency test key

typed_core.name: ending_account_value
typed_core.why: AS-3 (liquid asset sum), AS-4 (reserve base) — the headline value

typed_core.name: cash_and_cash_equivalents
typed_core.why: AS-3 — the most-liquid slice usable for cash-to-close

typed_core.name: securities_market_value
typed_core.why: AS-4 — marketable-securities value (often discounted to reserve-eligible), AS-3

typed_core.name: margin_or_securities_backed_loan_balance
typed_core.why: AS-11 (loans outstanding reduce usable portion), AS-3 (net liquid, not gross)
typed_core.prompt_hint: A negative margin/loan line reduces usable value; capture it as a positive balance in its own field, not folded into the total

typed_core.name: net_liquidation_value
typed_core.why: AS-3, AS-4 — value after margin/SBL payoff; the true usable figure

typed_core.name: vested_or_available_value
typed_core.why: AS-11 — the accessible/vested portion that actually counts

typed_core.name: liquidation_restrictions
typed_core.why: AS-11 — restriction/penalty terms; without it AS-11 cannot flag restricted use
typed_core.prompt_hint: Report restriction/penalty language verbatim; do not judge usability — rules judge, the extractor describes

typed_core.name: document_status_or_version
typed_core.why: processor — draft/final/corrected/amended changes whether the value is trustworthy

nested_lists.name: security_positions
nested_lists.shape_reason: a portfolio commonly holds 20-100+ positions, so per-field wrapping risks the 16,384-token ceiling — flat rows keep it light

fields.name: description
fields.why: AS-4/AS-3 position-level marketability — position identity for restricted vs marketable classification

fields.name: market_value
fields.why: AS-4/AS-3 — per-position value feeding the marketability discount

fields.name: asset_class
fields.why: AS-4/AS-3 — marketable fund vs restricted/thinly-traded stock

rejected.name: beginning_account_value
rejected.reason: no continuity rule for investment accounts (unlike bank AS-8); no consumer

rejected.name: investment_objective_or_account_type
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL; ownership captured by registration_type, no separate consumer

rejected.name: party_addresses / property_address / loan_number
rejected.reason: not on a brokerage statement / no consumer

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block
rejected.reason: a brokerage statement is not executed

rejected.name: account_transactions
rejected.reason: no rule reads investment transaction detail; large-deposit sourcing is a bank-statement concern

rejected.name: contributions_and_distributions
rejected.reason: no rule consumer for a taxable brokerage account

encoding_variations: Total value appears as 'Total Account Value', 'Ending Value', 'Total Portfolio Value', or 'Net Portfolio Value' — the last may already net a margin loan, so capture margin_or_securities_backed_loan_balance and net_liquidation_value separately to disambiguate gross vs net
Cash may be 'Cash & Cash Equivalents', 'Sweep/Money Market', or 'Core Account' — all belong in cash_and_cash_equivalents
Registration stated as a code ('JT TEN', 'IND', 'TOD', 'TRUST') or spelled out — carry the raw line so the split can be re-judged
Margin/SBL shown as 'Margin Balance', 'Loan Balance', or a negative line in the value roll-up — a negative number is a liability, not a value

drop it and rely on securities_market_value

open_questions.q: Dropped activity lists — confirm no large-deposit / sourcing rule (AS-1-style) applies to investment accounts
options: add account_transactions if a rule lands later
open_questions.recommendation: confirm no large-deposit / sourcing rule applies; if one lands later, account_transactions becomes a rule floor field

open_questions.q: statement_date vs statement_period_end — these may coincide on some issuers
open_questions.recommendation: keep both; cheap and disambiguates snapshot vs period statements

notes: This is an asset toward RESERVES and cash-to-close; the decision-relevant figures are the usable ones — value net of any margin/securities-backed loan, and the vested/accessible portion — not just the gross total.
statement_period_start reason_class was set to processor as a best guess: its 'recency/coverage' why cites no rule id and names no explicit reason_class.
